title: Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2, 11.11.x <= 11.11.1 fail to enforce playbook membership…
description: Mattermost versions 11.7.x up to 11.7.11, 11.10.x up to 11.10.2, and 11.11.x up to 11.11.1 contain a vulnerability where playbook membership management permissions are not properly enforced during the creation of a new playbook. This flaw allows a low-privileged user to assign the playbook_admin role to any user by submitting a specially crafted playbook creation request.
